The source already gives the full algebraic verification; it specifies no geometric braid representative or crossing picture, so omission of a strand diagram is not a mathematical or rendering defect.

As a greedy-extraction table, show A_0=sigma_1 sigma_2^2, Delta meet_L A_0=a_1, residual A_1=a_2, Delta meet_L A_1=a_2, and residual A_2=1.
Show the meet checks Delta meet_L(a_1a_2)=a_1 and Delta meet_L a_2=a_2, and state the equivalent left-weighting identity (a_1a_2) meet_L Delta=a_1.

Keep Delta=sigma_1 sigma_2 sigma_1=sigma_2 sigma_1 sigma_2 distinct from Delta^2; if permutation labels are included, use the stated map pi:B_3^+ -> S_3 with pi(a_1)=s_1s_2=(1 2 3) and pi(a_2)=s_2=(2 3).
